title: Priority of an Independent External Exception Review: Days of Drug Left against Review Time (Formulary Benefit)
content:
An external exception review under the Formulary Benefit is expedited when the days of the drug the member has left are fewer than the days a standard independent review takes. It is standard otherwise.

- **Days of the drug left.** The days supply of the member's latest shipped specialty fill of the drug, less the days from its ship date to the handling date.
- **Days of a standard independent review.** The formulary's standard external review hours divided by twenty-four.

## Decision grid

| Days left, compared with the days of a standard review | Priority |
|---|---|
| fewer | expedited |
| equal | standard |
| more | standard |

## Worked cases (hypothetical; standard external review of 72 hours, which is 3 days)

- Latest shipped specialty fill of 28 days, shipped 26 days ago. 2 days are left, which is fewer than 3, so the review is expedited.
- Latest shipped fill of 28 days, shipped 25 days ago. 3 days are left, which is not fewer than 3, so the review is standard.
- Latest shipped fill of 30 days, shipped 31 days ago. The days left are less than zero, which is fewer than 3, so the review is expedited.
